note: Campground at the Green County Fairgrounds, 2600 10th St, inside the city of Monroe; the sites line the barn rows and the east edge of the grounds. Most sites have 20- or 30-amp power; 14 have 50-amp. ATV trailers may park on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Operator camping page, 2024 campground map, Google and imagery read. Season May 1-Sep 30 -> May 1-Oct 15 (no camping fair week, July 15-19 2026); electric 30 -> 50 (map: 14 x 50A, 39 x 30A, 54 x 20A); sites 100 -> 104 (map); $40 FCFS confirmed (manual), monthly $600 and $5 dump in fee note; dump added. Fairgrounds test passes on the operator's general-public nightly offer.
flags: FAIRGROUNDS TEST: passes on the operator's wording - the camping page sells first-come nights to any camper all season ('Campers: $40.00/night/unit', register on arrival), open May 1 - Oct 15, closed only during Fair Week (July 15-19, 2026); no event-only restriction. Occupancy can't be checked (no booking engine). A monthly rate ($600) is posted; the map does not mark seasonal sites.

OWNERSHIP: the campground map says 'This property is privately owned' (the Green County fair association runs the grounds, not the county). Per the standing rule a fair association's campground stays local; reviewer may prefer private (then the US$50 gate passes at $40).
GOOGLE: 4.2 (296) for the fairgrounds as a whole, not the campground alone.
PIN 42.6022,-89.6243 is on the east side of the grounds by the 45-104 site rows: fine (Google's 42.6022,-89.6286 is the fairgrounds centre).
WEBSITE https://greencountyfair.net/camping/ and PHONE 608-325-9159 confirmed. Inclusion evidence current (dates now May 1-Oct 15, ~100 sites).
